verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of David. A Song. There will be silence before You, [and] praise in Zion, O God, And to You the vow will be performed.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩歌，交與伶長。）神啊，錫安的人都等候讚美你；所許的願也要向你償還。

verses.text: O You who hear prayer, To You all men come.
verses.textZh: 聽禱告的主啊，凡有血氣的都要來就你。

verses.text: Iniquities prevail against me; As for our transgressions, You forgive them.
verses.textZh: 罪孽勝了我；至於我們的過犯，你都要赦免。

verses.text: How blessed is the one whom You choose and bring near [to You] To dwell in Your courts. We will be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Your holy temple.
verses.textZh: 你所揀選、使他親近你、住在你院中的，這人便為有福！我們必因你居所、你聖殿的美福知足了。

verses.text: By awesome [deeds] You answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation, You who are the trust of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest sea;
verses.textZh: 拯救我們的神啊，你必以威嚴秉公義應允我們；你本是一切地極和海上遠處的人所倚靠的。

verses.text: Who establishes the mountains by His strength, Being girded with might;
verses.textZh: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定諸山，

verses.text: Who stills the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the tumult of the peoples.
verses.textZh: 使諸海的響聲和其中波浪的響聲，並萬民的喧嘩，都平靜了。

verses.text: They who dwell in the ends [of the earth] stand in awe of Your signs; You make the dawn and the sunset shout for joy.
verses.textZh: 住在地極的人因你的神蹟懼怕；你使日出日落之地都歡呼。

verses.text: You visit the earth and cause it to overflow; You greatly enrich it; The stream of God is full of water; You prepare their grain, for thus You prepare the earth.
verses.textZh: 你眷顧地，降下透雨，使地大得肥美。神的河滿了水；你這樣澆灌了地，好為人預備五穀。

verses.text: You water its furrows abundantly, You settle its ridges, You soften it with showers, You bless its growth.
verses.textZh: 你澆透地的犁溝，潤平犁脊，降甘霖，使地軟和；其中發長的，蒙你賜福。

verses.text: You have crowned the year with Your bounty, And Your paths drip [with] fatness.
verses.textZh: 你以恩典為年歲的冠冕；你的路徑都滴下脂油，

verses.text: The pastures of the wilderness drip, And the hills gird themselves with rejoicing.
verses.textZh: 滴在曠野的草場上。小山以歡樂束腰；

verses.text: The meadows are clothed with flocks And the valleys are covered with grain; They shout for joy, yes, they sing.
verses.textZh: 草場以羊群為衣；谷中也長滿了五穀。這一切都歡呼歌唱。
